answer_1.quote: We examine whether the dataset STORYANALOGY can enhance the ability of analogy generation. We evaluate FlanT5 , LLaMa , ChatGPT (OpenAI, 2022), and GPT-3.5 in zero-shot and few-shot settings using 40 source stories from the test set.

answer_2.quote: we calculate the Spearman's correlation between models' predicted similarity and the analogy scores (α) derived from annotations

answer_4.quote: A crowd annotation is conducted to evaluate the quality of the generated stories from the models mentioned above. Workers are provided with a source story and its corresponding generated target story.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to assess: (1) Whether the target story is an analogy for the source; (2) whether the target story is novel compared to the source; and (3) whether the target is plausible.
